analysis: Examined the two supplied base_text units of ProviderLoop+InferenceHandler.swift (lines 624-1525). They cover the inference task spawn, per-request shared-key setup, SSE frame encryption (emitSSE), terminal and error paths, and billing/usage and cache-receipt handling. The head-side changes are only visible via the truncated patch excerpt, so I could not fully verify them. The excerpt shows: a new optional `workFIFOGate` parameter on the handler; decoding replaced by `decodeInboundChatRequest`, which also parses body extensions (templateControls) in the same pass; and head ranges 445-453 and 561-565 whose contents are not visible. In the base source, the fail-closed behavior of T-008 holds. Key-setup failure and chunk-encryption failure both send an encryptionFailure inferenceError and return, with no plaintext fallback. The cache scope comes from remoteCache.scope, which is coordinator-authored, and the T-041 receipt path is unchanged in the visible text. No concrete regression is identifiable from the supplied evidence. Integration questions for the next pass: (1) whether `decodeInboundChatRequest` preserves the previous tool/function-call repair semantics and still uses the authenticated plaintext, so templateControls and cacheScope cannot be influenced by a consumer body field; (2) what `WorkFIFOGate` does, including whether it is released on every early-return path, since a leak could cause an availability problem (T-010); (3) the head-only changes at 445-453 and 561-565. Those excerpts are truncated and were not reviewed against the head text, so the conclusion is limited to the base context.
